record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set Adam learning rate to 1.1e-3 and existing embedding dropout to 0.08, retaining hidden width 128. Slightly larger updates and less input noise may improve fitting of the short histories without the capacity reduction that regressed. Keep features, embedding design, GRU depth, history length, readout, scoring and loss unchanged. Retain seed 42, at most 200 epochs, 200 batches per epoch and one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, couple a modest Adam learning-rate increase to 1.1e-3 with reduced embedding dropout of 0.08 to test faster fitting with less input noise. Retain width 128, the existing GRU architecture, loss, readout, training limits and one checkpoint per category. Predictor changes are unnecessary because architecture and inference behavior are unchanged.
